newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ICI Australia has limit on some operations.
newsitem.headline: ICI Australia has limit on some operations.

text.p: ICI Australia Ltd said on Monday that it had some agreements in place with ICI Plc which restricted operations to certain regions.
ICI Australia managing director Philip Weickhardt said the company had negotiated a total of 31 agreements with its former parent.
"The only two areas where we have a territorial restriction in the future are the refinished paints and canned coating areas," he told reporters.
Weickhardt described the net outcome of its agreements with ICI Plc as "neutral to positive".
"We felt they captured the vast majority of the benefits of our relationship with ICI plc and yet the extra flexibility we got from separating was a real upside," he said.
For its explosives division, ICI Australia had negotiated a wider area for its operations that included all of the Asia/Pacific region east of India, he said.
